question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom Phrase.

To turn over a new leaf

options.text: To have an inclination towards gardening
To turn your back on someone

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2' **i.e. **'To make a fresh start'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given phrase** "To turn over a new leaf" **is an idiom which means to start behaving in a better way, especially after a period of difficulties or bad behavior. (नई शुरुआत करना). 
 
• The phrase **"To make a fresh start"** captures the essence of this idiom, as it refers to beginning something again, typically in a better way after a failure or negative experience.

Therefore, the correct answer is- 'Option 2' i.e.** 'To make a fresh start'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'To have an inclination towards gardening' **means to have a liking or preference for gardening. (बागवानी के प्रति रुझान होना).
 
• **'To turn your back on someone'** means to reject or abandon someone.(किसी को ठुकरा देना).
 
• **'To reply brazenly'** means to respond in a bold and often disrespectful manner. (ढीठी से जवाब देना).
